facts.en: Completed a BSc in Computing at Fictional Institute D021 in 2020.
facts.zh: 2020 年在虚构院校 D021 完成计算机学理学学士学位。

facts.en: Worked as an internal tools developer at Fictional Employer D021 from 2021-02 to 2026-08.
facts.zh: 2021-02 至 2026-08 在虚构雇主 D021 担任内部工具开发工程师。

facts.en: Built a Python service that validated incoming inventory CSV files before loading them into PostgreSQL.
facts.zh: 开发 Python 服务，在库存 CSV 文件载入 PostgreSQL 前对其进行校验。

facts.en: Wrote SQL joins and reconciliation queries for that service; used Git pull requests for review.
facts.zh: 为该服务编写 SQL 连接和核对查询，并通过 Git 拉取请求接受审查。

facts.en: For 12 measured weekly imports, manual correction time fell from a median of 90 minutes to 35 minutes after validation was introduced; this was a team result.
facts.zh: 引入校验后，在测量的 12 次每周导入中，人工修正时间中位数从 90 分钟降至 35 分钟；这是团队成果。

facts.en: Added unit tests for 18 malformed-file cases and documented a local recovery procedure.
facts.zh: 为 18 种格式错误文件情况添加单元测试，并记录本地恢复流程。

facts.en: Paired with an operations analyst to clarify field definitions and demonstrate each monthly release.
facts.zh: 与运营分析师结对明确字段定义，并演示每月发布内容。

facts.en: Deployment was handled by a separate platform team; the candidate has no recorded Kubernetes administration work.
facts.zh: 部署由独立的平台团队负责；候选人没有已记录的 Kubernetes 管理工作。
